title: Fuel Filler Door
introduction:
The fuel filler door slides off its hinge after its retaining tab is released. I use the open-door drawing to orient myself, then the highlighted close-up to find the tab. Think of it as a sliding lid with a latch: release the latch before asking the lid to move.

A screwdriver is the specified release tool. The illustrations show the tab-release and door-removal directions; the hinge stays in place during this operation.

items.name: Screwdriver
items.detail: Use it at the highlighted retaining tab shown on the inside of the open fuel filler door.

items.name: Prevent an unexpected start
items.detail: Before working around the vehicle, disable remote start, if equipped, through the Central Display under Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup. Otherwise, the vehicle could be remotely started at any time, causing personal injury or death. Switch the ignition OFF and remove the key from the vehicle to prevent another person from starting the engine during service; an accidental start may cause serious personal injury.

items.name: Personal protection
items.detail: Wear eye and ear protection during vehicle service. Wear protective gloves when handling parts with pointed or sharp edges. Failure to use the applicable protection may result in serious personal injury.

items.name: Review applicable precautions
items.detail: Review [Health and Safety Precautions](#/document/G1693189) and the applicable portions of [Body Repair Health and Safety and General Precautions](#/document/G1693182) before work. This door-release operation does not call for sanding, grinding, welding or collision repair.

edits.text: Swing the fuel filler door open to expose its inside face and hinge attachment.
edits.why: The open position gives access to the retaining tab used in the next operation.

edits.text: Use a screwdriver to pry the highlighted retaining tab back in the illustrated direction. With the tab released, slide the fuel filler door off the fuel filler door hinge in the direction shown.
edits.why: The tab locks the sliding attachment. Releasing it allows the door to separate from the hinge without removing the hinge itself.

edits.text: Reverse the removal sequence: slide the fuel filler door back onto its hinge until the retaining tab engages, then close the door.
edits.why: An engaged tab restores the attachment that prevented the door from sliding off before removal.
